company.name: Portal Entryways
company.shortDescription: Portal Entryways upgrades existing handicap-accessible doors so they can be opened hands-free with any smartphone.
company.description: Portal Entryways exists to create a world where people of any physical ability can get anywhere, enjoying an environment that is safe, convenient, accessible, inclusive, and collaborative. Portal Entryways leverages technology to empower millions of people around the world with physical and mobility type disabilities to have greater access to information, opportunities, events, and experiences to achieve the potential as human beings.

aiResearchSummary.text: Portal Entryways is engaged in research and development of automated door systems, as described in the title 'Automated door system.' The abstract details a system utilizing processors and computer-readable mediums with instructions to control door operations. This work focuses on enabling hands-free access to handicap-accessible doors, aligning with the company's goal of smartphone-based entry solutions. Their R&D centers on integrating automation and digital control for accessible entryways.
